method.description: Adaptive filter: sinc (Fourier-domain harmonic keeping) or wavelet (-W)

wavelet_type.description: Wavelet family+order code (H/D/B families, U prefix = undecimated); only used with method=wavelet

wavelet_cutoff.description: Keep wavelet components above cutoff*sqrt(2*ln(nbin)) sigma; only used with method=wavelet

normalize.description: Normalize pol 0 to unit sum-of-squares (other polarizations scaled by the same factor) (-n)
